criteria.equivalent: Both memories make the same assertions, without unique additional content.
criteria.partial: They share an assertion, and at least one also contains unique assertions or conditions.

criteria.compatible: Both can be maintained, including equivalent, complementary, unrelated, different-role or different-time claims.
criteria.conflict: Both cannot hold in the same scope and time.
criteria.insufficient: Required role, purpose or time information is missing.
